metadata.author: sudo-ai-git
metadata.longDescription:
Deterministic detection of pytest config-leakage that silently corrupts agent-benchmark / function grading.

Answers: 'if I run python -m pytest <tests> inside this workspace, will it inherit a host coverage/abort gate that mis-scores passing code as failed?'

No LLM. No network. Catches the exact bug documented in sudo-ai-git/vulcanbench-findings (VulcanBench declarative grader mis-scoring every functional task as 0.0 due to a repo-root pytest-cov addopts leak).

Tools: inspect_workspace(path), check_addopts(path), summarize(analysis).
